note: Each slot is the immutable first capture of that slot (the base file) with its two clocks: asOf is the market timestamp the values describe, observedAt is when we fetched them. Later re-captures are listed in captures[] and live at their own tape/<date>/<HHMM>.rev-N.json path; the base bytes are never rewritten. Every absent slot or section is named in gaps[] with a code.
